title: Understanding L1 Regularization
text: L1 regularization, also known as Lasso, tends to produce sparse models by driving some coefficients to zero. This can help in feature selection.

title: Comparing L1 and L2 Regularization
text: While L1 regularization can help in identifying the most predictive features, it often results in a higher average loss compared to L2 regularization.

title: Evaluating Statements about L1 Regularization
text: Consider the statement: 'L1 regularization will generally result in higher average loss.' Is this statement true or false?

title: Feature Selection with L1 Regularization
text: L1 regularization is particularly useful when you want to reduce the number of features in your model, as it can set some coefficients to zero.
